sub_answers.text: Diana Fosha promotes therapeutic models and approaches that integrate relevant neurobiological processes, including implicit memory and cognitive, emotional and sensorimotor processing [d72248675s19p0]. Ricky Greenwald applies eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) and founded the Trauma Institute & Child Trauma Institute [d72248675s19p0]. Anna Baranowsky developed the Traumatology Institute and addresses secondary trauma and effective PTSD techniques [d72248675s19p0]. Prolonged Exposure (PE) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) are identified as strongly recommended treatments for PTSD and commonly used with first responders [d59119145s17p0][d59119145s16p0]. Trauma-informed care frameworks as articulated by SAMHSA, including the three E's, the four R's, six key principles, and ten implementation domains, are specified as a central model [d72248675s3p0].
